defects.summary: Historical source/live release drift is resolved by deploy run 31784115606: Kling and Wan are present, while inactive Seedance 1.0, Seedream 4.5, and Sora 2 Pro are absent. Retained because the Board compatibility evidence still references this finding.
Resolved in source and production: Fast rows now sell only 480p/720p. Retained as a historical ledger entry because Board compatibility evidence references the original 1080p finding.
Vendor schema and price snapshots refreshed 2026-08-14: Grok and HappyHorse rates match the signed workbook; the product intentionally sells a narrower duration/input envelope than the vendor APIs.
Resolved in source and clients: Recraft references are clamped to one. Retained as a historical ledger entry because Board compatibility evidence references the original ignored-input finding.

Resolved in source and Board compatibility evidence: Omni is explicitly a generic image-reference channel, not a positional first/last-frame model. Video/audio reference ports remain intentionally withheld because no signed product band exists; retained as historical evidence.
Vendor snapshots refreshed 2026-08-14: Kie Veo Fast/Lite and Grok/HappyHorse records match the workbook; Atlas developer Omni remains $0.112 per second. No sellable rung change is required.

Seedance routing/forceGateway metadata is now deployed and reconciled; negative_prompt remains intentionally unavailable because neither active route serializes it. Keep this contract ledger until a real negative-prompt route is wired.
Resolved by deploy run 31790198287: /health and /ready now return the immutable API image commit aa3126ac66082fbe1de2f8f9862e5ff36dc867d0, with DB/Redis readiness green.
Resolved in source and regression tests: Board preserves outputFormat=vector and the worker lifecycle already stores SVG MIME/extension; retained as a historical ledger entry.
